content.short: Dinari dShares issues RWA-backed tokens that create fractional, composable on-chain assets backed by shares.
content.description: Dinari (dShares) delivers the foundational infrastructure to bring traditional securities—stocks and bonds—onto the blockchain. Through smart contracts, these assets are represented as tokens, and the buying and selling workflow is automated by code. The system issues real-world asset (RWA)-backed tokens that establish fractional, composable on-chain positions backed by the underlying shares, broadening access to US equities and enabling fractional ownership of high-value assets that were previously out of reach.
